assets.rationale: Officially described as one of its most popular and successful slots.
assets.subject: Zeus, a powerful mature thunder god with a thick flowing white beard and swept white hair, stern expressive eyebrows, a gold laurel crown, white toga with generous sculpted folds, oversized polished gold shoulder armour and wrist cuffs, blue gemstone clasp. He holds a compact glowing electric-blue lightning bolt high beside his shoulder, no trident. Proud friendly heroic expression, broad chest, one hand extended in commanding gesture.
